title: P15.9-B5.4: /app/chat — Conversation layer on the canonical P15.8 contract (AppShell)
description: P15.9-B5.4 — ports the legacy P15.8 conversation UI to /app/chat inside AppShell: session sidebar (create/list/select/close, real titles/identities/counts, ?s= deep links, OPEN/CLOSED), chronological thread with role styling + MSG_PAGE=200 tail window + Load Earlier + message_id dedup, composer with single-flight idempotent turns, ambiguous-proposal project picker re-validated against canonical GET /api/projects, governed Mission Draft cards (all 6 states, exact persisted terms, expired/non-pending never confirmable), pinned ConfirmDialog confirm/reject + close, draft create/revise via supersedes_draft_id (new draft object, canonical defaults — nothing invented), confirmed-mission links to /app/missions/:id. Dedicated apiAdmin conversation wrappers suppress the legacy 401 window.prompt; legacy api/Chat.tsx/backend untouched. Per-op request ownership + AbortController for reads; possibly-committed POSTs never aborted. Element-level validation on sessions/messages/drafts/projects/proposals. UI-only; zero backend/schema/dependency changes.
